name: Projected Membership Queries Complexity
definition: The **Projected Membership Queries Complexity** of $\mathcal{H}$ is the largest membership-query complexity attained by any coordinate projection of $\mathcal{H}$.
graph_summary: Largest membership-query complexity among coordinate projections.
origin_references: Membership queries in the exact query-learning model are introduced in \cite{angluin1988queries}; this is their projection-monotone variant.

monotonic.proof: For every projection, the projected subfamily is contained in the projected original class. An exact membership-query decision tree for the latter also identifies a target in the former; maximizing over projections preserves the inequality.

p_monotonic.proof: Every projection of a projection is a projection of the original class. Hence the defining maximum of membership-query complexities cannot increase after a projection.

doubly_monotonic.proof: By definition, being monotonic under both subfamilies and projections is doubly monotonic.

c_monotonic.proof: A conditioning is restriction to a subfamily followed by a projection; hence doubly monotonicity implies c-monotonicity.
